reviews.title: Perfect fans for just about any PC case
reviews.comment:
Big pressure push. They cool better than I could've asked for. Very quiet until they need to be less quiet to provide better airflow. At or near idle, silent.
Excellent value from one of the only companies left that doesn't force you onto their own software just to adjust the fans or use the ARGB. They're all happily controlled by the FanControl app and SignalRGB via an Airgoo ARGB controller. There are no proprietary gymnastics in the wiring whatsoever. Full functionality with whatever you want to use to control them.
Cable length is typical. If you're wiring a new build, you'll want some PWM extenders and ARGB extenders so that you don't have to worry about super-tight fits for wire management reasons. For ARGB extenders, get some electric tape since they don't grab together on their own. A single wrap of electric tape solves that and, if done cleanly, looks just fine.
These fans don't have a hint of fragility to them, unlike the Corsair fans I've dealt with recently. Color accuracy seems good, but I only have these and the 120mm version as case fans.
They are exactly what I was looking for in ARGB fans. Big CFM, big pressure, totally open controls.
reviews.author: Ferret

reviews.title: Solid fans
reviews.comment:
I picked up a couple of these 140mm fans to upgrade my PC’s cooling setup, and I’m seriously impressed with their performance.
Performance & Airflow: These fans move a lot of air. The PWM control range is perfect — they’re silent when idling and ramp up smoothly under load. My CPU and GPU temps dropped after swapping out my old fans.
Noise Level: At higher RPMs, they can get loud. The motor design really minimizes vibration and hum I barely notice they’re running most of the time.
Build Quality: The materials feel premium and durable. The blades are sturdy and perfectly balanced, and the overall construction feels like something you’d find on a much more expensive fan.
Ease of Installation: Daisy chainable 4-pin PWM and rgb connectors make setup simple. The cable length is generous, and I had no issues fitting them into my case (HAVN HS 420).
Overall, these are top-tier fans for anyone who cares about both cooling performance and silence. Excellent airflow, premium quality, and smooth operation totally worth the price.
reviews.author: Patrick Cook

reviews.title: Great pressure, flow, and color match. Cant wait for reverse blade.
reviews.comment: Great quality fans that move alot of air. Keeps my 5090 Astral coated in fresh cool air and I used a second 3 pack to set up my 420mm Arctic rad with a Push-Pull which keeps my 9950X3D nice and chilly. The cables are very long, able to reach the top of the motherboard from the bottom right install location. Would be nice to have connectors right at the fans so we could tailor the length depending on where the fans will be, I just wrap the excess around the fan itself, and use some wire harness tape to keep it hidden. The RGB is very consistant with other items in my case, including the Astral's LED strip, fans from thermaltake, and case lights from LianLi, even matches the MSI case fan I used while waiting for the thermaltake. The performance is what I expect, but they can be loud if they ramp up to 2000 RPM. I have adjusted them in FAN CONTROL as Jays2Cents describes in his video. I have no complaints other than I need some REVERSE BLADE to match.... soon I hope they will be available.
reviews.author: IamME

reviews.title: Nice fans for the price
reviews.comment: Nice fans for the price.  They aren't Noctua by any stretch of the imagination, but they are much cheaper and get the job done.  They are fairly loud at high RPMs, but virtually silent at lower RPMs.  They are cheap, have ARGB, can be daisy chained and move a lot of air.  I'd buy them again.
reviews.author: Terry Moore

reviews.title: Incredible value for the money!
reviews.comment:
The Arctic P14 Pro fans work incredibly well and keep my components very cool, especially when gaming. I personally haven't seen the temps go higher than 64C. Definitely great value for the money! They can be a bit loud at times but I've been tweaking my fan curves as needed. Nothing too egregious.
For reference, I'm using a 9800x3D and an RTX 5070Ti in a Fractal Design North XL case. I'm using 3 P14 Pros for intake in the front and one for exhaust in the rear, paired with an Arctic Liquid Freezer III Pro 360 up top.
My biggest gripe with these fans is probably the installation process. They're easy to daisy chain but getting the screws in the first time took forever since the fans aren't pre-threaded. I resorted to using a drill. This is the case for most fans as far as I know so it isn't a drawback for these fans specifically.
